text:
maria: Kickoff — preparing v0.23.0 release sweep. Freeze at 18:00 UTC, cut at 22:00 UTC. Calling owners: QA, Docs, Security, Release lead. Any blockers?

jim: QA update: staging smoke run 1 failed on reroute test. Investigating, suspect timing flake.

alex: I'll grab the reroute test, could be intermittent; will push fix by 16:30.

devbot: Reminder: run `./scripts/bump_version.sh 0.23.0` and update the CHANGELOG before tagging.

sam: Docs: drafted changelog entry in PR #4321. Needs doc review + screenshots check. @maria @qa_lead please glance.

qa_lead: I can do docs review at 17:00. Planning full regression after merge — might take ~45m.

security-bot: Security scan scheduled for 20:30 UTC. If there are dependency bumps, please add SBOM and call out risk.

security: Noted — we need approval for lodash bump (4.17.20 -> 4.17.21). Low risk but add 'security: reviewed' label when done.

maria: @pat can you review the lodash bump when it's in a PR? We want to avoid last-minute blocks.

pat: On it. Will review immediately after PR is up.

jim: @oncall heads up: quiet window from 17:50-22:15. Please avoid non-essential merges.

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll be available during cut and monitoring post-cut metrics.

alex: Fix pushed and merged to staging. Re-ran smoke, now green. Shout if you see anything odd.

sam: Docs PR updated and screenshot attached. Ready for review.

qa_lead: Regression green on staging, approving the QA gate.

pat: Security review done, added 'security: reviewed' label and comment + CVE scan passed.

maria: Great — status check: version bump ✅ changelog PR ✅ docs ✅ QA ✅ security ✅. We'll tag at 22:00 UTC. Any last asks?

jim: Can someone run a quick canary traffic plan once cut? I'll coordinate.

maria: I'll trigger canary rollout and monitor. Thanks team :tada:

devbot: Auto-Reminder: Create release tag: `git tag -a v0.23.0 -m "v0.23.0"` then `git push origin v0.23.0`.

sam: Copy. Will watch the tag.

maria: Tagging done at 22:00 UTC, starting rollout. Closing thread once metrics look stable.

oncall: All clear so far, latency within SLOs, error rate steady. :+1:
